blurb: Our most popular fishing excursion is for striped bass, or stripers as they are commonly called here in Maine. Stripers are the premiere light tackle and fly fishing saltwater inshore gamefish of Maine and New England. During the months of May through September we are obsessed with chasing these awesome fighting fish by boat and shore. We fish hard, we have fun and we want to share with you the Maine fishing
